description: This file defines the StreamInterface interface as part of the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, describing methods for handling streams of data such as reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving metadata.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Reads all data from the stream into a string, starting from the beginning to the end.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and any underlying resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Separates any underlying resources from the stream, rendering the stream unusable afterward.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream's read/write pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the remaining contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or a specific metadata key.
